lane: H77H: Piedmont-Bajada Alluvial-Fan Toe Pinchout, Synthetic/Antithetic Scarp Polarity & En-Echelon Sinter-Relay Bridge (H77H-PBF)
assignment_irregularity: No separate single-method paragraph was supplied in the 2026-10-21 prompt (same class as IR-77-06, IR-78-01, IR-H77E-01, IR-77G-01); five untried geological hypotheses were formulated and ranked in research/h77h_hypotheses.md, and the top-ranked candidate H77H-1 (H77H-PBF) was preregistered here before Experiment 1 (IR-H77H-02).
single_method_paragraph: From SHA-256-pinned competition and public USGS/GDR datasets (zero SGMC bedrock-contact inputs, zero prior submission rasters, zero dist_known_fault_px usage): (1) compute the sub-cell piedmont tail-slope anomaly (slope_max - slope_p90) * aspect_coherence inside the 1-12 deg alluvial-fan/bajada slope envelope (det_elev_slope) from 10 m USGS 3DEP DEM statistics (topo_10m_derived_100m_u8.tif), explicitly deconfounded for horizontal Pleistocene Lake Lahontan (~1332 m) and Lake Bonneville (~1463 m, ~1552 m) wave-cut shoreline berms; (2) compute the seamless 1 m LiDAR + 10 m DEM synthetic/antithetic scarp-to-wash polarity ratio log1p((downface_max + 1.25*upface_max)/(cross_max + 8)) * coh100 (respecting lidar_valid > 0 -> NaN outside 75.4% LiDAR coverage and bridging across the 24.6% gap via 10 m profile curvature * aspect_coherence / (slope_std + 1)) plus antithetic hanging-wall graben step fraction upface_max / (downface_max + upface_max + 5) * step_max; (3) compute the range-front footwall-to-bajada transition gradient |grad(steep_frac)| * aspect_coherence * log1p(relief_local), cross-break fluvial stream-power drop Delta(chi_ksn_max) * log1p(chi_log10_area), and buried bedrock bench |iso_grav_anom_hg_signed| * |grad(depth_to_base_surf)|; (4) fuse fossil silica-sinter (1.5x) and carbonate-travertine (1.0x) mound kernel density (paleo_geothermal_regional.zip) with 2-meter temperature probe F2mDAB/T2m plumes (2m_temperature_probe_INGENIOUS_regional_data.zip), chemical geothermometer disequilibrium (gdr_wellspring_in_footprint.csv), geodetic transtensional release (geod_dilaterate * geod_shearrate * geod_2ndinv), and weathering-normalized radiometric regolith provenance contrast |grad(Th/K)|; and (5) derive 3 fold-strict Leave-Own-Component-Out (LOCO) en-echelon structural relay channels strictly from fold['visible'] fault traces during holdout (elliptical tip-to-tip relay bridge potential, piedmont-corroborated continuation cone, and off-fault splay collar). Validate all 15 channels via single-feature ROC-AUC leakage canaries (<= 0.90) and dual-seed whole-component buffered hide-and-recover holdout (gems57-pooled-hide-v2, seeds 20 and 30, alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, 300 m triangular kernel), emit 37,654 discrete binary dots (> 3 px from catalogue) via capacity-guarded 300 m submodular cover, verify pre-placement surface and final-dot uniqueness via vendor/gems57/uniqueness.py, and write the single-band float32 GeoTIFF in [0,1] with nodata=None via unmodified vendor/gems57/submission_writer.py.
hypothesis: In the Great Basin, unmapped Quaternary faults and blind geothermal conduits cluster in three geomorphic-structural settings systematically missed by 1:250,000 aerial mapping: (a) gentle (1-12 deg) coalescing alluvial fans (bajadas) where low-relief (<1.5 m) scarps leave the 100 m cell's 90th-percentile slope low while spiking the 10 m sub-cell tail slope (slope_max - slope_p90) with high strike aspect_coherence and low cross-wash incision (cross_max); (b) intrabasin antithetic graben faults 0.5-2.5 km basinward of the range-front bedrock-to-bajada pinchout (|grad steep_frac|) above buried gravity-basement benches; and (c) en-echelon fault step-over bridges where ascending geothermal fluids deposit opaline silica sinter or calcite travertine that self-seals and obscures brittle surface scarps.
named_non_fault_mimicking_process: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan (~1332 m) and Lake Bonneville (~1463 m, ~1552 m) wave-cut shoreline berms around piedmont aprons (which follow flat equipotential elevation contours without subsurface gravity/basement steps), radial non-tectonic alluvial-fan channel terrace risers (high cross_max), and highway/railroad embankments.

data/bridge/existing_faults.tif (used ONLY for holdout split, fold-strict LOCO visible-component relay features, pixel-exact visible-fault masking, and >3 px off-catalogue emission collar)

canaries: Every new H77H static (12) and fold-strict LOCO (3) channel tested alone on withheld positives vs off-catalogue negatives on both Seed 20 and Seed 30 draws; symmetric ROC-AUC > 0.90 triggers an immediate leakage stop.
